set_aside.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
set_aside.text: - assemble_mapped_lists: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build, for each MappedList in the order given, the list its elements' outputs make in element order, and write and publish nothing: a value list is one StoredValue whose bytes are canonical_bytes of the JSON array text made of the elements' stored bytes — each read with read_value_bytes — in element order, separated by commas, between [ and ], whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the elements' StoredValues — read through read_records with one RecordsById naming their value_ids —, its value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent; a file list is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements' SpooledFilesRefs.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: MappedList.elements are PortRef values, so they may be FileFactsRef values, but the required value-list path needs value_ids and stored bytes and the file-list path needs SpooledFileKeys; which passage must change, or how is FileFactsRef reconciled?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change

set_aside.subject: deliver_input
set_aside.text: - deliver_input: [BEHAVIOR] MUST resolve the source to exactly one of two results before the check: a written StoredValue together with its canonical bytes, or a SpooledFilesRef; each result is checked and returned where it is resolved, with the StoredValue, the bytes and the files it was resolved with, so no value that might still be None reaches fit_port_value, a JsonCandidate or a BytesContent.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: A RecordedSource, including one used through ListElementSource, may hold a FileFactsRef, but FileFactsRef is neither of the two results deliver_input is required to resolve; which passage must change, or how is that variant reconciled?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change

set_aside.subject: record_flow_output
set_aside.text: - record_flow_output: [BEHAVIOR] A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7). A RefusedError or StoreInternalError from put_value_bytes and a failed record_change are broken invariants raised as StoreInternalError.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: RecordedSource.ref is a PortRef, but SpooledFilesRef and FileFactsRef have no value_id even though the behavior requires using its ref's value_id; which passage must change, or how is the ref narrowed to StoredValuesRef?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
